experiment: E100 Amendment 2 (the last): does 'fed' reach beyond copying? Job A re-reads the sum of single reverts against a written reference on each state's own site and checks whether emoticon's fed reading is in-context copying; job B reads a constructed non-copy pair, the strong-bigram sharpen map against its shuffled twin
advice: reports/reviews/2026-11-05_review_e100-next-fable-advice.md (Fable; adopted as written: stages, bars, leans, course changes, cost sources)
why: the independent check (reports/reviews/2026-11-05_review_e100-independent-check.md, job 52919) found every state that reads fed by the sum is a copy map, and its 4-MLP written plant reads 0.64, 0.72 and 0.86 on the copy, rank-1 and cipher sites: the fixed bars are site-dependent
limit: a new circuit built from old parts still reads as reuse

definitions.sum: the sum of the 28 single parts' own shares (fed_rules.reverts_sum; E100 Amendment 1's rule), unit lo, nats
definitions.plant: experiments/fed_or_written/plants.py: per part p a minimum-norm write X_p (perturb.key_write: X_p a_k = the unembedding row of key k's answer, a_k the mean of p's input at the read position over the windows holding key k, W0, fp32) into block b's down_proj (an MLP) or block b's o_proj columns of head h (a head); written by construction
definitions.plant_keys: a key table's site (E90's kv_site, sites.KV and the class map windows and the sharpen windows): the table's train windows keyed by the key at half (the check's spread_plant.py writes); every other site (E62's, E53's whole rows, the trigger tasks'): the site's own reads keyed by their target
definitions.profile: w_p = sqrt(share_p) / ||X_p||_F, share_p the state's own ||dW||^2 share of part p (the 28 parts as locator.part_reverted cuts them; the check's part_norms.py), so the plant's per-part norm profile equals the state's; an MLP's share goes into its down_proj alone, a head's into its o_proj columns alone
definitions.W: the plant's sum of single reverts, one common scale alpha (perturb.match, rel tol 5%, as spread_plant.py:71-77) so the plant's G on the site is the state's G
definitions.rho: the state's sum / W (fed_rules.rho), nan unless the reference is ok
definitions.G: the state's mean over the site's reads minus W0's, unit lo; job A takes each table row's G and sum as saved in table_amend1.json (stage 0 re-reads one)
definitions.kept: with E62's copying heads at their natural-text means (copying.ablated) on both the state and W0: (state - W0) / (state's G intact) over the site's reads

settings.rows: every row of experiments/fed_or_written/results/table_amend1.json (35 E100 rows, 20 Amendment 1 rows), each on its E100 site (locator_table/sites.py TASKS[task].site; E99's poles on e62_copy)
settings.copy_rows_source: Fable section 3: E62 copy, copy-24 seeds 0-7, ident32, forbidden copy. Fable counts 13 rows; these are 3 + 8 + 2 + 2 = 15 table rows
settings.written_rows_source: Fable section 3: lookup, cipher-24 seeds 0-7, rand32, the Pile cipher (T8 cipher, E53's whole rows): 3 + 8 + 2 + 2 = 15 rows
settings.slow_sites_note: read last within stage 1 (whole rows, about 1.4 s per read, E100 stage1.json T8 cipher 117 s for 86 reads)
settings.e99_large_source: E100's predictions.json settings.e99_large; the class map and twin states are there too (sha256 from experiments/definition_verify/results/stage4_class.json .trained)
settings.class_sites: experiments/open_pair/results/large/amend7/windows_class_{map,shuffled}_trained.pt held-out windows (E99 stage 4's sites; sha256 against stage4_class.json .sha256)

copying.heads_source: E62's prefix-scored copying set as E99 filed it (definition_verify predictions.json wide_copy '2,3+2,4+3,4', from E62 Amendment 5, TRIED.md line 140; Fable's 'all prefix-scored heads off')
copying.means: experiments/induction_cue/results/large/heads.pt 'means' (E62's natural-text head means, CP.head_means), sha256 recorded
copying.control_source: E62's in-context copy map seed 0 on its own site: the gain the heads must carry if they are the copying route. Copy-24 is not used: its value is the key token itself, not an earlier token
copying.earlier: emoticon's held-out windows holding the target token at any position up to and including the read position

sharpen.key_ranks_source: E54's candidate keys (keydependent_elicit predictions.json key_ranks; keydep.vocab)
sharpen.selection_source: E54's selection windows (rows with index % 5 != 0, kv.windows, seed 1)
sharpen.p_min_source: Fable section 2: keys filtered to W0's P(top-1 after 'M key') at or above 0.1
sharpen.value_rule: W0's top-1 next token at half (argmax of kv.key_distributions, the arithmetic mean over the key's windows; the rank-1 recipe, open_pair/amend1.py build_maps); the top-1 may not be the key itself (that would be copying); values distinct
sharpen.draw_source: E54's k and key draw (elicit.draw_keys: seeded order, a key skipped when its value is taken)
sharpen.task_windows_source: E54's task windows (kv.windows on Pile train rows 0..32767, 500, seed 0; data.split_windows, held-out = row % 5 == 0)
sharpen.k_source: E58's 24 trained keys; Fable's early check 'at least 24 keys'. The first 24 drawn keys (frequency-rank order) still strong on the task's train windows (fed_rules.strong_keys); every window of the other drawn keys is dropped
sharpen.twin: the sharpen's values permuted over the same keys so no key keeps its own (fed_rules.twin_values, Sattolo's cycle): same windows, keys and value words, the key-to-guess link broken (Fable: 'the same values permuted over the keys'; E58 Amendment 6's no-link cipher idea). Each value's W0 P at its twin key is reported, no band filed
sharpen.recipe: E54's (keydep.finetune: finetune_arm_a, Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL 1, clip 1, 300 steps, bf16 autocast), checkpoints every step 1-30 and 100, 300 (KD.CIPHER_CHECKS; checkpoints do not change the trajectory: the batch generator is the loss's alone). Sharpen at E12's scored step (keydep.scored_step: first of 10, 30, 100, 300 with held-out P >= 0.5). Twin at the step in 1-30 whose summed ||dW|| is nearest the same seed's sharpen (elicit.matched_step, as E54/E58 matched the cipher)
sharpen.saved: results/large/dW_{sharpen,twin}_s{0,1}.pt (bf16, ~57 MB each) and windows_{sharpen,twin}_trained.pt; read as saved

thresholds.fixed_gap_source: the fixed bars' gap, 0.62 - 0.40 (Fable section 3); the site-relative rule is adopted iff rho_written - rho_fed >= 0.22
thresholds.w_floor_source: Fable section 3: W under 0.5 reads 'site unreadable'
thresholds.kept_max_source: the plan's course change: emoticon losing half its gain or more with the heads off is copying; the control must lose at least half
thresholds.norm_tol_source: Fable section 4: the twin's ||dW|| within 5% of the sharpen's
thresholds.w_unexplained_source: Fable section 4: 'both fed with W at or above 0.8: unexplained, report and stop'
thresholds.reread_zero_source: E100's predictions.json thresholds; locator_table's Job reads them, this job does not use them

rule.reference: fed_rules.reference_status: match status not ok -> 'no reference: match <status>'; state G at or under 1 nat -> 'no reference: gain at or under the floor'; W not finite or <= 0 -> 'no reference: plant sum not positive'; W < 0.5 -> 'site unreadable: W under the floor'; else ok. W over 1 is used as it is; negative single reverts are kept
rule.bars: fed_rules.site_bars: rho_fed = the largest rho over the copy rows, rho_written = the smallest over the written rows, rows with no reference left out; adopted (kept_rule 'site-relative') iff both pools hold a finite rho and rho_written - rho_fed >= fixed_gap; otherwise kept_rule 'fixed' and each row's W is printed beside. spread = the copy rows' range of rho, reported; no_call = gap < spread, reported
rule.reading: fed_rules.rho_reading. Fixed: sum_reading on the sum with 0.40 / 0.62 / 1 nat. Site-relative: G at or under 1 nat -> 'no gain'; 'site unreadable' -> so; no reference -> the fixed reading, basis flagged; else rho at or under rho_fed -> fed, at or over rho_written -> written (a bar's own value takes its side), else between
rule.copying: fed_rules.copying_reading: the control must keep at most 0.5 of its gain, else 'no call'; a state keeping at most 0.5, or more than half its windows holding the target earlier, reads 'copying'; else 'not copying'. Task reading: fed_rules.task_reading over the two seeds
rule.strong_keys: fed_rules.strong_keys; fewer than 24 -> stop (exit 1): no sharpen pair, the column goes over as the check worded it
rule.job_b_early: the zero update reads G = 0 exactly on both sites; each state's step-1 gain on its site finite and positive (fed_rules.step1_ok); the twin's summed ||dW|| within 5% of the sharpen's (fed_rules.norm_matched); each a stop
rule.pair: fed_rules.pair_outcome on the two seeds of each map: every sharpen fed and every twin written -> 'fed / written (<rule>)', the sharpen pair the column's positive control; every seed of both written -> 'detects copying-type reuse, not reuse in general'; every seed of both fed with every sharpen W >= 0.8 -> 'unexplained, report and stop'; else 'as read'
rule.job_b_needs: results/amend2.json .kept_rule is 'site-relative' or 'fixed' (written at the end of job A's stage 1); job B refuses otherwise. With the fixed rule kept, job B still runs on the fixed bars (Fable section 4)
rule.edge_cases_tested: tests/test_fed_rules.py: match cap / no gain / plant sum <= 0 / gain exactly 1 nat -> no reference; W 0.49 -> site unreadable, W 0.5 ok, W 1.3 kept; gap exactly 0.22 adopts, 0.2199 does not; an empty or all-nan pool keeps the fixed bars; rho exactly at a bar takes its side; a no-reference state falls back to the fixed bars; control keeping 0.6 -> no call; kept exactly 0.5 -> copying; earlier exactly 0.5 -> not copying; 23 strong keys; a key whose top-1 is itself; twin of 24 values has no fixed point; norm 5% off passes, 5.1% fails; pair outcomes incl. an empty map
rule.do_nothing: W0 as the state: G 0 -> 'no gain' under both rules, never fed; its shares are 0/0 so it has no profile (job A reads no such row). A zero update reads G exactly 0 on job B's sites (stage 0's stop)

expected.stage0: sum 0.39511 and W 0.63885 within 1e-3 (the same fp32 path and site; the plant's per-key means are now taken in fp64, about 1e-7 relative)
expected.W: on the key tables the check's 4-MLP plant read 0.64 (copy-24), 0.72 (rank-1), 0.86 (cipher); the profile-matched plant has a third of its norm in heads and about 8 of 28 parts, so W is expected between 0.5 and 1 there, lower on copy sites than on cipher sites; E53's whole rows and the trigger sites are unmeasured
expected.rho_bars: if W tracks the 4-MLP plant: copy rho 0.47-0.63, cipher 0.78-0.86 (Fable's division), gap about 0.15, under 0.22: the fixed bars would stand
expected.control_copying: E62 copy seed 0 keeps well under half its 12.6 nats with its copying heads off (E97 located (2,4) alone at 0.56-0.65 of the gain by removal)

leans.emoticon_keeps_half: 50% (Fable): emoticon keeps more than half its gain on both seeds with the heads off
leans.class_both_written: Fable: the class map and its twin both read written (class at most a little lower)
leans.sharpen_fed_twin_written: 45% (Fable): job B reads every sharpen seed fed and every twin seed written
leans.both_written: 55% (Fable): job B reads every seed of both written, or no sharp mechanism

course.gap_under_0.22: fixed bars stand, each site's W printed beside; job B still runs on the fixed bars
course.emoticon_copying: B holds on every fed row; job B decides
course.under_24_strong_keys: stop; hand the column over as the check worded it
course.sharpen_fed_twin_written: label the column 'fed / written, site-relative' with the sharpen pair as positive control; hand it to definition-lead
course.both_written: label it 'detects copying-type reuse, not reuse in general'; hand over; no third amendment

cost.job_a: about 10-15 min on a debug L40: start-up 1.5 min (E100 amend1.out); per key-table state the plant's match (12-grid points and bisection, up to ~50 reads) and 28 reverts at ~0.025 s per read (amend1.out: 29 reads in 0.7 s), ~2-3 s; E62 sites ~0.08 s per read (E100 stage1.json 7 s for 86 reads), ~6 s; E53 whole rows ~1.4 s per read (117 s for 86 reads), ~70-110 s for each of 4 states; part shares on CPU ~1 s per state
cost.job_b: about 8-10 min: start-up 1.5 min, vocabulary and selection windows ~1 min (unmeasured: keydep.vocab reads 32,768 Pile rows), four 300-step fine-tunes at ~25-40 s each (inventory line 110, job 46332: six fine-tunes in ~2.5-3 min, TRIED.md:127), reads ~3 s per state

outputs: results/amend2.json (stage0, stage1 rows with plant and reading, bars, kept_rule, stage2 copying and class, outcome); results/amend2_sharpen.json (stage0 keys and tables, states, outcome); results/large/ for job B's windows and dW. E100's and Amendment 1's files unchanged
